quote: I got into digital marketing because I like figuring out why something works — not just posting content and hoping. Over the past year, I've worked across SEO, social media, and paid campaigns for brands in food and lifestyle, and I'm currently deepening that with a diploma in digital marketing. Still early in this journey, but every brand I've worked with has taught me something new.
seoDescription: From keyword research to rank tracking, meta titles, descriptions, and content optimization that actually gets read.
socialDescription: Planning content calendars, post scheduling, Canva asset design, Meta Ads support, and influencer barter partnerships.
educationText: IDCM Advanced Diploma Candidate • M.Com (Calcutta Univ) & B.Com (Hons) (St. Xavier's).
